title: The Instructions to the Substitute
youtube_title: The Instructions to the Substitute | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A story belongs to the person still speaking it.
summary: At a library window seat, the ferryman begins to tell Sora about instructions meant for a substitute, practiced aloud. Sora wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
